name: Own a Gym
desc:
Run your own Gym. 
Buy Gym Equipment, Stock shelves with supplements, sell gym memberships, set prices as you'd like, take payments, expand and design your store. 
security, janitors and Product licenses are upcoming.
Thanks for playing!

TIPS:
- Attract more people into your gym with high quality Gym Equipment.
- Gym members will likely buy more expensive gym memberships if they like your gym. Increase Gym Rating.
